testcase.name: COSMETIC ticksSince is the exact nanosecond difference divided by 5e7 with one rounding below 2^53 ns (section 3)
Mixing domains or passing null is an IllegalArgumentException; an unrepresentable difference is an ArithmeticException (sections 3, 7)
GAME ticksSince is the exact tick difference converted once to double (section 3)
Factories set the domain and the raw value; a null domain is rejected (section 3)
